inputs.prompt: Create the final continuity frame of the same journey. Show exactly one Matvey from behind, full body, walking away from camera along a narrow island jungle footpath. Far ahead in the distance the trail clearly ends at a dense wall of tangled green vines and foliage, a visible dead end. Keep the dead-end geography, tropical foliage, dappled daylight and earthy path from image 2. Match the same child, glasses, cream sailor shirt, navy vest, red neckerchief, tan trousers, brown shoes and rolled map from images 1 and 3. Rear view only: his back and back of head are visible, never facing camera. The bridge is behind the camera and must not appear anywhere in this final frame. No bridge, no signpost, no shell, no second person, no open passage, no text, no title plaque. Photorealistic cinematic wide shot, 16:9.
inputs.negative_prompt: bridge, suspension bridge, bridge in distance, front view, face visible, looking at camera, duplicate child, extra people, signpost, arrow, shell, open path through vines, text, writing, watermark, cartoon, illustration, CGI, extra limbs, deformed hands
